No other-axis review record was read; the prior same-axis original-scope review remains applicable because all ten original PR54 blobs are unchanged.

No missing/partial requirement, unasked scope expansion or incorrect apparent implementation was found. The delta remains exactly within the three authorized paths (spec lines 85-110). evaluate uses trimmed description, then trimmed text, then P2_006_BROWSER_EVALUATION_FAILED (118-131); command errors also retain a nonempty fallback. No page, Cookie, Token or request-body dump was added. Browser startup is inside protected cleanup; every closer executes and original plus cleanup failures are retained (179-198). Controlled SSE rejects missing/destroyed/ended responses, awaits the write callback and is awaited before REFRESH_COMPLETE and timeline-count assertions (200-219). The entry abort check prevents allocation for the existing pre-aborted lifecycle consumer. Resource diagnostics and the same reload fix in the authorized workbench test address the shared infrastructure scope. Existing focused receipts record AlmaLinux 8.10 WSL, Node 24.18.0, Chrome 154.0.8037.92 and 10/10 passing focused cases; startup-failure diagnostics record server_closed=true. These are inspected receipts, not new runs by this reviewer or a full-certification claim. Applicable ordinary CI and the single new full remain separate gates; C-to-H evidence and both certify workflows require full SUCCESS. Both failed prior fulls remain valid failure history. SS011 AC096/AC099 remain incomplete and AC102 partial; CJK, Windows whole-business, natural GC, physical 2C4G and live acceptance remain unproven. PR54 stays OPEN without merge, real run, approval creation, WeCom sends, hospital data or parent-Gate authority. No tests, build, full, certify or live command was executed in this review.
